elsewhere.role: default user directory, not read because CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR points elsewhere

settings.screen: name-based, one level deep plus the env map; enabledPlugins are refused unless the pinned --settings switches each off; modelSettings are read one level deeper; published keys and the per-call ambient stability check are the real protection

instrument.note: scripts/eval/instrument.mjs at the candidate is byte-identical to the instrument runs 53 to 64 pinned (sha256 7b80cc91); the full run keeps that reviewed instrument unchanged.

configuration.why: The 1.19.1 patch's eval, run again: run 64 (on the configuration folder <private configuration directory>) ended terminal at call 306 of 1079 when the API's safeguard stopped one scenario call twice and the client answered on a model outside the admitted pair, so on the maintainer's word this run moves the configuration folder to <private configuration directory> (an unscored probe there re-sent the stopped calls 8 times, none stopped), with nothing else moved: the claude profile's judge is claude-fable-5-2 at an explicit, declared reasoning effort high (evals/model-profiles-v1.json sha256 a32941eca8010cf96abe8099c0fce5017212c1c0baeceb6bacd10e07d4119a48) on the pinned client 2.1.322, and 1.19.1 is the third release since run 56's full measure, so this run measures every case itself, three samples each, with calibration run afresh and nothing carried.
